findings.passage: This embarrassing blunder by New Jersey Democrat administrations exemplifies why the Senate must pass the SAVE America Act. This commonsense and deeply needed legislation would require prospective voters to present valid proof of U.S. citizenship prior to registering to vote in federal elections, as well as to show government-issued photo identification before casting federal ballots.
findings.note: Press statement issued in his name after New Jersey disclosed that about 6,600 non-citizens were registered through a state software error. He urges the Senate to pass the SAVE America Act, describing its proof-of-citizenship and photo ID requirements.

findings.passage: Election security is fundamental, and I urge my colleagues in the Senate to immediately take up the SAVE America Act for a vote.
findings.note: Same statement; calls for an immediate Senate vote on the bill.

findings.passage: This disturbing revelation out of Trenton—perhaps only the tip of the iceberg—confirms what Republicans have known all along: that current U.S. voter-registration systems are inadequate, ill-maintained, and putting the integrity and security of our elections at grave risk.
findings.note: Same statement; says current voter-registration systems are inadequate. Related: voter-roll maintenance and registration-system integrity.

findings.passage: “As a member of the House Election Integrity Caucus, I am committed to protecting voter identification laws across the country and safeguarding the right to vote that so many brave men and women in uniform have courageously fought—and died—to defend,” Smith said.
findings.note: Quoted in his office's release on House passage of the SAVE Act (HR 8281). He says he belongs to the House Election Integrity Caucus and is committed to protecting voter identification laws.

findings.passage: “Noncitizen voting makes our elections vulnerable to foreign interference and violates the constitutional principle that voting is a right reserved for American citizens,” said Smith. “To ensure that Americans can have confidence in our election process and results, we must take additional steps to protect this sacred right and ensure that only United States citizens are able to vote in our elections.”
findings.note: Same release; his reasons for backing proof of citizenship to register and for stopping noncitizen voting.

His office's release calls him 'a cosponsor of the legislation' (HR 8281, SAVE Act: proof of U.S. citizenship to register in federal elections) and says the House passed it with his vote. The vote itself is already on file; this adds the cosponsorship.

findings.passage: Secure elections are the bedrock of democracy; we must take all steps necessary to ensure that votes are cast only by those who have a right to vote.
findings.note: Quoted by Breitbart News (reposted on his official site) in a story on the reply from New Jersey's governor to a House letter he signed about noncitizen registrations. Calls for transparency and a fix from the state.
